en.title: ENEM study schedule: how to use the last 17 days
en.meta: About 17 days are left before Brazil's ENEM exam. How to build a short study schedule with up to 4 tasks a day, essay practice, subject review and rest, and track it on iPhone with Mochi.
en.h1: ENEM study schedule: the final stretch with short lists
en.lead: Students searching for an ENEM study schedule two and a half weeks before the exam do not need an 80-row spreadsheet. They need to know what to do today, and to finish it.
en.answer: Split the days until 8 November into three blocks: review of what you have already studied, practice tests with error correction, and two light final days. Each day gets a list of at most 4 concrete tasks, for example: 1 essay, 20 maths questions, 1 humanities topic and correcting yesterday's mistakes. Keep today's list in a Home Screen widget and tick each item as soon as it is done.
paras: The final stretch before ENEM has a familiar problem: the schedule made in March fell behind, and the urge is to make up for everything at once. A 15-task day looks responsible in the morning and turns into guilt at night. With 4 tasks you can see the end of the day, each tick is a quarter of the way, and the next morning you actually want to open the list again. Over the next weeks, consistency beats one heroic Sunday.

A split that works for 17 days: days 1 to 7, review the topics you have already studied and that show up most in past papers; this is not the time to start a new subject from scratch. Days 8 to 15, a practice test or a past paper every other day, always with the following day kept for correcting mistakes. Days 16 and 17 stay light: summaries, enough sleep, official photo ID and a black ballpoint pen with a transparent barrel set aside, and the route to the test site checked.

ENEM runs on two Sundays, 8 and 15 November, and that changes the schedule. The first covers Languages, Human Sciences and the essay; the second, Natural Sciences and Mathematics. So the essay and humanities come first now, and the week between the two days belongs to the sciences: one short list per day with maths, physics, chemistry and biology questions, without trying to review everything.

A task only goes on the list if it fits in under an hour and you can tell when it is done. "Study biology" does not work; "redo the 10 ecology questions I got wrong" does. "Practise the essay" becomes "write 1 essay on a past-paper topic and check it against the 5 competencies". If a task is left over at night, it does not roll over by itself: decide whether it goes on tomorrow's list or leaves for good.

A list only works if you see it. On iPhone that means a Home Screen widget rather than an app buried in a folder; with an Apple Watch you can follow your tasks on your wrist without picking up the phone and drifting into social media mid-study. Keep reminders for things with a time: Saturday's practice test, the prep-course class. Mochi is built around that gesture: write the task, tap the little circle when it is done. The free version includes 2 lists with up to 4 tasks each, 5 themes and 1 emoji pack, enough for a "Today" list and a "Review later" list. Premium, an in-app purchase, unlocks unlimited lists and tasks, all 101 themes and all 11 emoji packs.

Mark the dates: 8 November (Languages, Humanities and essay) and 15 November (Sciences and Maths).
Create a "Today" list with at most 4 tasks, always including 1 essay or error-correction task.
Break every vague task down until it fits in under an hour.
Add the widget to your Home Screen and set reminders only for timed practice tests and classes.
In the evening, tick what you did, delete what no longer makes sense, and pull 1 or 2 items up from "Review later".

en.fits: Mochi suits ENEM candidates who want a short, pretty, always-visible study schedule: today's list in a widget, reminders for practice tests and classes, tasks on the Apple Watch. It is not a question bank or a video-lesson platform: the content comes from your own material, and Mochi helps you remember and finish.

In the final stretch, rarely. If you finish all 4, pull one more from "Review later". That is more motivating than starting with 12 and pushing 8 to tomorrow.
Is Mochi's free version enough?
For this method, yes: 2 lists with up to 4 tasks each, 5 themes and 1 emoji pack. Premium, an in-app purchase, unlocks unlimited lists and tasks and all 101 themes.

Yes. Mochi lets you follow your tasks on the Apple Watch, as well as through Home Screen widgets.

Make one short list per day with only Natural Sciences and Mathematics: past-paper questions and correcting mistakes. Rest goes on the list too.

loc.title: メールのパスワード付きZIPをiPhoneで開く方法（PPAP対策）｜Zipbox 解凍
loc.meta: 取引先から届いたパスワード付きZIP、iPhoneで開けない？別メールのパスワードを入れて、40個の中からPDFを1つだけ取り出すまでを手順で。Zipboxは端末内で処理、通信なし・広告なし。
loc.h1: メールで届いたパスワード付きZIPを、iPhoneで開いて必要なファイルだけ取り出す
loc.lead: 「添付ファイルはパスワード付きZIPです。パスワードは別途お送りします」。外出先でこのメールを受け取って、iPhoneで中身を見られずに困った人向けのページです。
loc.answer: パスワード付きZIPは、iPhoneの標準機能だけでは暗号化方式によって展開できないことがあり、RARや7zはそもそも開けません。ZIPを端末内で展開できるアプリで共有メニューから開き、別メールで届いたパスワードを入れれば、中身を一覧で確認して必要なファイルだけ取り出せます。Zipbox 解凍はファイルをどこにも送らず、通信もしないので、取引先の資料をオンラインの解凍サイトにアップロードする必要がありません。
paras: 日本の会社では、添付ファイルをパスワード付きZIPにして、パスワードを2通目のメールで送る運用（いわゆるPPAP）がいまも残っています。困るのは移動中です。メールアプリで添付をタップしても中身が出てこない、ファイルAppに保存しても開かない、という相談がいちばん多いパターンです。まず添付ファイルを長押しして「ファイルに保存」を選び、ファイルが本当に端末に保存されたかを確かめてください。

次に、パスワードを入力できる解凍アプリを選びます。見るべきなのは、パスワード付きと分割ファイルに対応しているか、そして処理が端末の中で完結するかの2点です。Zipbox 解凍はZIP・RAR・7zのパスワード付きと分割ファイルに対応し、展開する前にファイル一覧を見ながら写真・PDF・テキストをプレビューして、必要な1つだけを取り出せます。App Storeで購入する買い切りのアプリで、アプリ内課金・サブスクリプション・広告はありません。
最後に情報の扱いです。パスワード付きで送られてくるのは、見積書や契約書、個人情報を含む名簿など、外に出したくない資料だからです。検索で出てくる「オンライン解凍」サイトに上げると、パスワードと中身を第三者に渡すことになります。端末の中で展開すれば、ファイルもパスワードもiPhoneの外に出ません。取り出したPDFは、そのままメールや共有シートで社内に転送できます。

アプリがパスワード付き・分割ファイルへの対応を明記しているか
展開が端末内で完結し、サーバーにアップロードしないか
ファイルを開くまでに広告やカウントダウンが挟まらないか
steps: メールアプリで添付のZIPを長押しし、「ファイルに保存」でiCloud Driveか「このiPhone内」に保存する。
ファイルAppでそのZIPを長押しして「共有」を選び、Zipboxを選ぶ。Zipboxから保存先のフォルダを開いてもよい。
2通目のメールに書かれたパスワードを入力する。コピーして貼り付けると打ち間違いを防げる。
一覧で中身を確認し、写真やPDFはプレビューしてから、必要なファイルだけにチェックを入れて取り出す。
取り出したファイルを共有シートからメールやファイルAppに送り、社内の担当者へ転送する。

端末内で展開し、通信しないと明記されているか
パスワード付きの資料をサーバーに上げると、守秘の意味がなくなる
全部ではなく1ファイルだけ取り出せるか
40個入りのZIPからPDFを1つ見たいだけのときに容量と時間を使わない
loc.fits: Zipbox 解凍は、通勤電車や出張先でパスワード付きZIPのメールを受け取る会社員、7zで写真をもらった人、Safariで落とした圧縮ファイルが開けない人に向いています。13形式を端末内で処理し、通信もアカウントも広告もない、App Storeで購入する買い切りのアプリです。
faq: パスワードが合っているのに開けません。
全角・半角や前後のスペースが混ざっていることが多いので、2通目のメールからコピーして貼り付けてください。分割ファイルの場合は、すべてのパーツが同じフォルダにあるかも確認してください。
ZIPの中身をサーバーに送ることはありますか？
Zipboxは通信を行わず、アカウントもログインも不要です。展開もプレビューもすべて端末の中で行います。
取り出したPDFを社内に送るには？
取り出したファイルを共有シートから開けば、メールやファイルApp、iCloud Driveにそのまま渡せます。

en.title: How to open a password-protected ZIP email attachment on iPhone (Japan's PPAP habit) with Zipbox
en.meta: A client emails a password-protected ZIP and sends the password separately. Open it on iPhone, enter the password and pull out just the one PDF, on device, with no uploads and no ads.
en.h1: Opening a password-protected ZIP email attachment on iPhone, then taking out only what you need
en.lead: "The attachment is a password-protected ZIP; the password follows in a separate email." This page is for the moment that email reaches you on the train and the file will not open.
en.answer: Depending on how it was encrypted, a password-protected ZIP may not extract with the iPhone's built-in tools, and a RAR or 7z will not open at all. Open the archive from the share sheet in an extractor that works on the device, paste the password from the second email, then look inside and take out only the files you need. Zipbox: Unzip RAR, ZIP & 7z never sends the file anywhere and makes no network requests, so a client's documents never go to an online unzip site.
paras: Many Japanese companies still send attachments as password-protected ZIPs and mail the password in a second message, a routine known locally as PPAP. It is awkward away from a desk: tapping the attachment in Mail shows nothing useful, and saving it to Files does not open it either. Start by long-pressing the attachment, choosing Save to Files, and checking that the archive really landed on the device.

Then pick an extractor that accepts a password. Two things matter: explicit support for password-protected and multi-part archives, and processing that stays on the phone. Zipbox handles password-protected and multi-part ZIP, RAR and 7z, lets you browse the file list and preview photos, PDFs and text before extracting, and pulls out just the item you choose. It is a paid App Store download where one purchase covers every feature, with no in-app purchases, subscription or ads.

Finally, handle the content with care. Files arrive password-protected because they are quotes, contracts or lists with personal data. Uploading them to an online extractor hands both the password and the contents to a third party. Extracting on the phone keeps the file and the password on the device, and the extracted PDF can be forwarded from the share sheet.

Whether the extension is .zip, .rar or .7z, and whether it is split into .001 or .part1 volumes
Whether the app states support for password-protected and multi-part archives

Whether an ad or countdown stands between you and the file
steps: In Mail, long-press the ZIP attachment and choose Save to Files, into iCloud Drive or On My iPhone.
In Files, long-press the archive, tap Share and choose Zipbox, or open that folder from inside Zipbox.
Paste the password from the second email; copying avoids typing mistakes.
Browse the list, preview photos or PDFs, and tick only the files you actually need before extracting.
Send the extracted files from the share sheet to Mail or Files and forward them to your team.

You need one PDF out of forty, not the whole archive on your phone
en.fits: Zipbox: Unzip RAR, ZIP & 7z suits commuters and business travellers who receive password-protected ZIPs by email, people sent photos as a 7z, and anyone with a Safari download that will not open. It handles 13 formats on the device, with no network, account or ads, as a paid App Store download.
faq: The password is right but the archive still will not open.
Copy the password from the email instead of typing it; full-width characters or stray spaces are the usual cause. For split archives, keep every part in the same folder.
Does Zipbox send the archive to a server?
No. Zipbox makes no network requests and needs no account or sign-in; extraction and preview happen on the device.
How do I forward the extracted PDF?
Open the extracted file from the share sheet and send it to Mail, Files or iCloud Drive.

loc.title: PDF schwärzen auf dem iPhone – dauerhaft statt nur schwarzer Balken | Mask My File
loc.meta: Ein schwarzer Kasten über dem Text reicht nicht: Der Text darunter bleibt oft kopierbar. So schwärzen Sie PDF und Fotos auf dem iPhone dauerhaft, prüfen die Kopie und senden sie, alles auf dem Gerät.
loc.h1: PDF auf dem iPhone schwärzen, sodass der Text wirklich weg ist
loc.lead: Mietbewerbung, Gehaltsnachweis, Arztbrief: Sie wollen das Dokument schicken, aber nicht jede Zeile darin. Diese Seite zeigt, worauf es beim Schwärzen ankommt, bevor Sie auf „Senden“ tippen.
loc.answer: Ein schwarzes Rechteck aus einer Markierungs- oder Zeichenfunktion verdeckt den Text oft nur optisch; darunter lässt er sich weiter markieren, kopieren oder durchsuchen. Dauerhaft geschwärzt ist ein PDF erst, wenn der Inhalt an dieser Stelle entfernt wird und die neue Kopie geprüft ist. Mask My File schwärzt in Bildern und PDF dauerhaft, entfernt Metadaten, wo das Format es erlaubt, und öffnet die neue Kopie erneut zur Prüfung, bevor „Private Ready“ erscheint. Alles läuft auf dem iPhone, ohne Konto und ohne Hochladen.
paras: Der häufigste Fehler beim Schwärzen ist der Balken, der nur oben aufliegt. In vielen PDF-Programmen ist ein schwarzes Rechteck eine Anmerkung: Wer die Datei öffnet, sieht schwarz, aber die Textebene darunter ist noch da. Ein Doppelklick, Strg+A oder die Suchfunktion bringen IBAN, Steuer-ID oder Geburtsdatum wieder hervor. Bei Fotos und Screenshots ist es ähnlich, wenn man mit einem halbtransparenten Stift übermalt oder nur unscharf macht.

Für eine echte Schwärzung brauchen Sie drei Dinge: einen deckenden Balken, der den Inhalt an der Stelle ersetzt, das Entfernen von Metadaten wie Autor oder Aufnahmeort, und eine Kontrolle der fertigen Datei. Mask My File findet private Daten, bevor Sie eine Datei senden, schwärzt dauerhaft nur, was Sie auswählen, und prüft die neue Kopie. Gesichts- und Barcode-Erkennung markieren lediglich Bereiche zu Ihrer Prüfung; nichts wird ohne Ihre Auswahl verändert. Bei vielen Unterlagen verarbeiten Sie bis zu 100 Dateien mit eigener Vorschau.

Der zweite Punkt ist, wo das passiert. Online-Dienste zum Schwärzen verlangen, dass Sie genau das Dokument hochladen, das Sie schützen wollen. Mask My File verarbeitet alles auf dem Gerät: kein Konto, keine Werbung, kein Tracking, kein Hochladen von Inhalten. Die Texterkennung läuft lokal. Das ist gerade bei Gesundheitsdaten, Ausweiskopien und Kundenakten der Unterschied, auf den es ankommt.

Gehen Sie die Seiten in der Vorschau durch und zoomen Sie bei kleiner Schrift bis 5× hinein.
Wählen Sie Name, Adresse, IBAN oder Ausweisnummer aus; markierte Gesichter und Barcodes prüfen Sie einzeln.
Schwärzen Sie dauerhaft und entfernen Sie Metadaten, wo das Format es zulässt.
Warten Sie auf „Private Ready“ und senden Sie erst dann die neue Kopie, nicht das Original.

en.title: How to redact a PDF on iPhone so the text is really gone, not just covered | Mask My File
en.meta: A black box over text often leaves the text underneath selectable. Redact PDFs and photos on iPhone permanently, check the new copy and share it, all on the device.
en.h1: Redacting a PDF on iPhone so the text is actually removed
en.lead: A rental application, a pay stub, a medical letter: you need to send the document, but not every line in it. This page covers what matters before you tap Send.
en.answer: A black rectangle drawn with a markup or shape tool often hides text only visually; underneath it can still be selected, copied or searched. A PDF is properly redacted when the content in that spot is removed and the new copy has been checked. Mask My File applies permanent solid redaction to images and PDFs, removes metadata where the format supports it, and reopens the new copy to verify it before showing Private Ready, all on the iPhone with no account and no upload.
paras: The most common redaction mistake is a box that only sits on top. In many PDF tools a black rectangle is an annotation: the reader sees black, but the text layer is still there, and select-all or search brings a bank number, tax ID or date of birth straight back. Photos and screenshots have the same problem when they are painted over with a semi-transparent pen or merely blurred.

Real redaction needs three things: an opaque block that replaces the content, removal of metadata such as author or location, and a check of the finished file. Mask My File finds private details before you send, permanently hides only what you choose, and verifies the new copy. Face and barcode detection only mark regions for your review. For a stack of paperwork it can protect up to 100 files at once, each with its own preview.

The second question is where it happens. Online redaction services ask you to upload the very document you are trying to protect. Mask My File processes everything on the device, with no account, advertising, tracking or content upload, and its text recognition runs locally. For health records, ID copies and customer files, that is the difference that matters.

Wait for Private Ready and send the new copy, not the original.

Often not: in a PDF the text layer can survive underneath and be copied. Check that the content in that spot is actually replaced.

Face and barcode detection only mark regions for your review. You decide what is redacted, and detection does not identify a person.

loc.title: 층간소음 측정, 아이폰으로 dB와 시간 기록 남기는 법 | dB Halo 소음 측정기
loc.meta: 윗집 발소리·쿵쿵 소리, 감으로 말하면 대화가 안 됩니다. 아이폰으로 dB와 피크, 소리가 난 시각을 기록하고 그래프 PDF로 정리하는 순서. 기기에서만 처리, 원본 오디오 저장 안 함.
loc.h1: 층간소음, 아이폰으로 몇 dB인지 재고 언제 났는지 기록하기
loc.lead: 밤 11시마다 들리는 쿵쿵 소리. 관리사무소나 윗집에 말하려면 “시끄러워요”보다 “몇 시에 몇 dB”가 필요합니다. 이 페이지는 그 기록을 남기는 방법을 정리했습니다.
loc.answer: 층간소음은 한 번의 측정보다 여러 날의 기록이 설득력이 있습니다. 아이폰 소음 측정기로 현재·평균·최고·피크 레벨을 보고, 소리가 바뀐 시각을 이벤트 기록으로 남긴 뒤, 날짜별로 그래프 PDF나 CSV로 내보내 두세요. dB Halo는 측정과 기록, 내보내기를 모두 기기에서 처리하며 원본 마이크 오디오를 저장하지 않습니다. 다만 측정값은 추정치이고 인증된 전문 소음계가 아니므로, 공식 판단이 필요하면 관리사무소나 전문 기관의 측정을 함께 요청하세요.
paras: 층간소음 상담에서 가장 먼저 듣는 말은 “언제, 얼마나 자주요?”입니다. 기억으로 답하면 서로 느낌을 주장하는 대화가 되기 쉽습니다. 그래서 기록은 숫자(dB)와 시각, 그리고 반복성 세 가지를 갖추는 것이 좋습니다. 같은 방, 같은 위치에 아이폰을 두고, 소리가 시작될 때 측정을 켜 두면 최고값과 피크, 평균이 함께 남습니다.

측정 앱을 고를 때는 숫자만 크게 보여 주는지, 기록을 남기는지를 보세요. dB Halo는 큰 dB 숫자와 Halo 안전 구간 표시, 현재·최저·평균·최고·피크 레벨, 소리가 바뀐 시각을 남기는 이벤트 기록을 제공합니다. A/C/Z 주파수 보정을 고를 수 있고, 저음이 울리는 소리는 FFT 스펙트럼과 스펙트로그램으로 어느 대역인지 볼 수 있습니다. 기록에서 측정을 골라 그래프가 담긴 PDF 보고서나 CSV로 내보낼 수 있습니다.
사생활도 중요합니다. 밤새 측정하려면 마이크를 켜 두어야 하는데, 집 안의 대화까지 녹음되는 건 원하지 않을 겁니다. dB Halo는 계정·광고·추적이 없고 모든 처리를 기기에서 하며, 직접 녹음을 시작한 경우에만 AAC 파일을 만듭니다. 수면 일지는 코골이, 말소리, 기침 같은 소리를 분류해 시간순으로 정리하지만 원본 오디오는 저장하지 않습니다.

앱의 측정값은 추정치이며 인증된 전문 소음계가 아닙니다. 상담 자료로 기록을 정리하는 데 쓰고, 공식 측정이 필요하면 관리사무소나 전문 기관에 요청하세요.
밤새 측정하면 집 안 대화가 녹음되나요?
dB Halo는 원본 마이크 오디오를 저장하지 않으며, 직접 녹음을 시작한 경우에만 AAC 파일을 만듭니다.

A/C/Z 주파수 보정을 고를 수 있고, FFT 스펙트럼과 스펙트로그램으로 어느 대역의 소리인지 확인할 수 있습니다.

en.title: How to measure and log noise from upstairs neighbors on iPhone (dB, peaks and times) | dB Halo
en.meta: Footsteps and thuds from upstairs are hard to describe from memory. Record dB, peaks and the time each sound happened on iPhone, then export a graph PDF. Processed on device; raw audio is not saved.
en.h1: Measuring upstairs neighbor noise on iPhone and keeping a dated log
en.lead: The thumping starts at 11 p.m. again. To talk to building management or the neighbors, "what time and how loud" works better than "it's noisy". This page covers how to keep that record.
en.answer: For neighbor noise, several days of records persuade more than a single reading. Use a sound meter on iPhone to watch the current, average, maximum and peak levels, keep a time-stamped event log of when the sound changed, and export each day as a graph PDF or CSV. dB Halo measures, logs and exports on the device and does not save raw microphone audio. Its readings are estimates and it is not a certified sound level meter, so ask building management or a professional when an official measurement is needed.
paras: The first question in any noise complaint is "when, and how often?" Answering from memory turns it into one feeling against another. A useful record has three parts: a number in dB, a time, and repetition. Keep the iPhone in the same room and the same spot, start measuring when the sound begins, and the maximum, peak and average are kept together.

When choosing an app, check whether it only shows a big number or also keeps a record. dB Halo shows a large live dB reading with the Halo safety ring, minimum, average, maximum and peak levels, and a time-stamped event log. You can choose A, C or Z weighting, and for booming low sounds the FFT spectrum and spectrogram show which frequency band is loud. Selected measurements export as visual PDF reports or CSV data.

Privacy matters too. Measuring overnight means leaving the microphone on, and nobody wants the household's conversations recorded. dB Halo has no account, ads or tracking, processes everything on the device, and creates an AAC file only when you explicitly start a recording. The Sleep Journal classifies sounds such as snoring, speech, coughing and impacts in time order without saving raw audio.
look: Whether average, maximum and peak are kept, not just the current value
Whether the time of each sound is logged automatically
Whether dated records export as PDF or CSV
Whether processing stays on the device without saving raw audio
Whether the app is clear that its readings are estimates
steps: In the room where the noise is worst, place the iPhone on a shelf at the same height and use the same spot every time.
Start a dB Halo measurement when the noise begins and check that maximum, peak and the event log are filling in.
For booming low sounds, look at the spectrum view to see which frequency band stands out.
Save the session and repeat at the same time of night for several days.
Pick the dated sessions in History and export a graph PDF or CSV to show building management.
rows: A single thud shows up in the peak, not the average
Time stamps in the event log
Shows a pattern such as "repeated after 11 p.m."
Dated reports read better than a pile of screenshots
en.fits: dB Halo fits people who need dated records of neighbor noise and parents checking how loud a bedroom really is. It measures, analyzes, logs and exports on the device with no account, ads or tracking. Readings are estimates and do not replace a certified sound level meter.
faq: Can iPhone dB readings be official evidence?
App readings are estimates and dB Halo is not a certified sound level meter. Use the log to organize your case, and ask building management or a professional for an official measurement.
Will measuring overnight record our conversations?
dB Halo does not save raw microphone audio; an AAC file is created only when you explicitly start a recording.
Does it pick up low booming sounds?
You can choose A, C or Z weighting, and the FFT spectrum and spectrogram show which frequency band the sound sits in.

loc.title: Texte défilant sur iPhone : pancarte de concert ou d'aéroport lisible de loin | LED Moving Text
loc.meta: Transformer l'écran de l'iPhone en bandeau lumineux défilant pour un concert, une arrivée à l'aéroport ou un comptoir bruyant : taille, vitesse, couleur, mode vertical et miroir. Sans compte.
loc.h1: Faire un texte défilant sur iPhone qu'on lit depuis le fond de la salle
loc.lead: Un prénom à brandir dans le hall des arrivées, un message pour l'artiste pendant le concert, une consigne au-dessus d'un comptoir : quand la voix ne porte pas, l'écran doit se lire d'un coup d'œil.
loc.answer: Pour qu'un texte défilant se lise de loin, trois réglages comptent : des lettres qui occupent toute la hauteur de l'écran, une vitesse assez lente pour lire le mot entier, et une couleur vive sur fond noir. LED Moving Text s'ouvre directement sur l'aperçu : on tape, on règle taille, vitesse et couleur, puis une pression passe en plein écran. Le mode vertical à quatre-vingt-dix degrés donne des lettres encore plus hautes, et l'écriture en miroir sert pour une vitrine ou un pare-brise. Aucune inscription n'est demandée.
paras: Au concert, la pancarte en carton a deux défauts : elle ne se voit plus dès que les lumières baissent, et elle ne dit qu'une seule chose. L'écran du téléphone, lui, s'éclaire tout seul et change de message entre deux chansons. Le piège, c'est la lisibilité : un texte trop petit ou qui défile trop vite devient une traînée de couleur. Choisissez un message court, deux à quatre mots, et augmentez la taille jusqu'à ce que les lettres touchent les bords.

À l'aéroport ou à la gare, le but est d'être repéré avant de repérer. Un prénom en grandes lettres fixes ou qui défilent lentement se lit à travers le hall des arrivées. Pour un chauffeur ou un retrait au bord du trottoir, l'écriture en miroir permet de poser le téléphone contre la vitre et d'être lu de l'extérieur. Dans LED Moving Text, l'aperçu est l'éditeur : le texte, la vitesse, la taille et la couleur changent dès que vous y touchez, et le bouton Pause bien visible fige l'affichage.

Quand il faut enchaîner plusieurs messages, par exemple le prénom, puis « Par ici », puis le numéro du vol, vos derniers messages restent à portée de doigt : pas besoin de tout retaper entre deux annonces. Le clignotement réglable attire l'œil dans un hall bondé, et les cent huit couleurs de texte permettent de reprendre la couleur d'un groupe ou d'un club pour être reconnu tout de suite.

en.title: How to make scrolling text on iPhone that reads from the back of a concert or arrivals hall | LED Moving Text
en.meta: Turn your iPhone screen into a scrolling LED sign for a concert, an airport pickup or a noisy counter: size, speed, color, a sideways mode and mirrored text. No account needed.
en.h1: Making scrolling text on iPhone that people can read from far away
en.lead: A name to hold up at arrivals, a message for the band between songs, a notice over a busy counter: when your voice will not carry, the screen has to read in one glance.
en.answer: Three settings decide whether scrolling text reads from a distance: letters that fill the full height of the screen, a speed slow enough to read the whole word, and a bright color on black. LED Moving Text opens straight onto the preview: type, set size, speed and color, then one tap goes full screen. The sideways ninety-degree mode makes the letters taller still, and mirrored text works through a shop window or windscreen. There is nothing to sign up for.
paras: At a concert, a cardboard sign has two problems: it disappears when the lights go down, and it only says one thing. A phone screen lights itself and can change message between songs. The trap is legibility: text that is too small or scrolls too fast turns into a smear of color. Keep the message short, two to four words, and raise the size until the letters touch the edges.

At an airport or station, the goal is to be spotted first. A name in large still letters, or scrolling slowly, reads across an arrivals hall. For a driver or a kerbside pickup, mirrored text lets you rest the phone against the glass and be read from outside. In LED Moving Text the preview is the editor: text, speed, size and color change the moment you touch them, and the clearly labeled pause button freezes the motion.

For events with several instructions, Cue Flow runs a sequence: one message per line, step backward or forward live, or set a 2 to 20 second timer with optional repeat. Event crews, speakers and queues keep a prepared run of signs without leaving the full-screen board.

Pick a bright color and raise the size until the letters fill the screen.
Swipe to set the speed, then test from three meters away; if you cannot read the whole word, slow it down.
Tap to go full screen; turn the letters ninety degrees for extra height.
For a window or windscreen, switch on mirrored text before resting the phone against the glass.

en.fits: LED Moving Text suits fans at concerts, people waiting at arrivals, drivers and event crews: scrolling or still text, one hundred and eight colors, a sideways mode, mirrored text and an adjustable blink rate, with nothing to sign up for.

Shorten the message, raise the size and slow the scroll; the sideways mode gives taller letters.

Yes, mirrored text is made for a shop window or a windscreen.

No, the app opens straight onto the preview with nothing to sign up for.

loc.h1: Como fazer foto 3x4 no celular que sai no tamanho certo na impressão
loc.lead: Matrícula da escola, crachá do trabalho, ficha de inscrição: a foto 3x4 aparece quando menos se espera. Esta página mostra como resolver em casa, com o iPhone, sem errar o enquadramento.
loc.answer: Uma boa foto 3x4 depende de três coisas: o rosto na posição certa dentro do quadro, um fundo liso e claro, e uma impressão no tamanho real. No Snapport Lite você tira a foto ou escolhe uma da fototeca, alinha topo da cabeça, olhos e queixo com as guias, troca o fundo por branco ou cinza-claro e exporta em JPEG, PNG ou PDF, inclusive em folha de impressão. Todos os modelos de tamanho e ferramentas de edição podem ser usados, a primeira exportação está incluída e tudo é processado no próprio aparelho, sem conta.
paras: O erro mais comum na foto 3x4 feita em casa não é a câmera, é o enquadramento. Rosto muito pequeno, cabeça cortada no topo ou ombros tortos fazem a foto parecer improvisada mesmo com boa luz. As guias de topo da cabeça, linha dos olhos e queixo resolvem isso: você encaixa o rosto e o recorte fica proporcional. Com pinça, arrastar e girar dá para ajustar o ângulo sem tirar a foto de novo.

O segundo ponto é o fundo. Parede com textura, porta ou cortina aparecem na foto e chamam atenção. en.h1: Making an ID photo on your phone that comes out the right size on paper
en.lead: School enrollment, a work badge, an application form: small ID photos turn up when you least expect them. This page shows how to do it at home with an iPhone without getting the framing wrong.
en.answer: A good ID photo depends on three things: the face in the right place inside the frame, a plain light background, and a print at true size. In Snapport Lite you take a photo or pick one from your library, line up the top of the head, eye line and chin with the guides, switch the background to white or light gray, and export as JPEG, PNG or PDF, including a print sheet. Every size preset and editing tool can be used, your first export is included, and everything is processed on the device with no account.
paras: The most common mistake with a home-made ID photo is not the camera but the framing. A face that is too small, a head cut off at the top or tilted shoulders make a photo look improvised even in good light. Head-top, eye-line and chin guides fix that: you fit the face to the guides and the crop stays in proportion. Pinch, drag and rotate adjust the angle without reshooting.

The second point is the background. Textured walls, doors and curtains show up and draw attention. Snapport Lite lets you keep the original background or switch to white, light gray, blue, red or a custom color, compare before and after, and refine the edges. Gentle brightness, contrast, warmth and sharpness controls keep you looking natural rather than filtered.

Finally, printing. Sending a loose photo to a print shop can come back stretched or the wrong size. Choose a size preset or set a custom size in millimeters, inches or pixels with your own DPI, and export a ready print sheet. Remember the app only edits your photo: passports, visas and ID cards are issued by the authority you apply to, and their rules count more than any preset.

en.title: How to fix a blurry photo on iPhone: what shake, missed focus and low light can and cannot recover | Unblurry
en.meta: A dark party group shot, a child's shaky photo, an old out-of-focus print. What each kind of blur allows, and how to correct it on iPhone alone. Photos never leave the device.
en.h1: Fixing a blurry photo on iPhone: pick the mode by the kind of blur
en.lead: When the one photo you cannot retake is blurry, the first question is whether it can be fixed at all. This page sorts out what is possible for each kind of blur.
en.answer: Blurry photos recover differently depending on the cause. Camera shake and soft focus respond well to sharpening, grain from dark rooms improves with denoise and low-light correction, but a subject that moved a long way during the exposure cannot be fully restored. Unblurry corrects by cause with eight modes, and you can press to compare before and after. Everything is processed on the iPhone, and photos are never uploaded.
paras: Start by identifying the blur. If the whole frame is slightly smeared, it is camera shake; if the background is crisp and the face is soft, focus was missed; if a dark shot looks grainy, it is noise. Indoor party photos at the end of the year often combine darkness, noise and shake, and correcting them step by step looks more natural than a single pass.

Unblurry has eight modes: Auto Clear for everyday blur in one tap, Sharpen for soft focus and camera shake, Denoise for grain and high-ISO noise, Low Light to brighten dark shots, Document for text and whiteboards, AI Super Resolution where an on-device neural model rebuilds detail, 4× Upscale, and Portrait & Restore for faces and old photos. A before and after slider lets you spot overcorrection quickly.

Where the photo goes matters too. Few people want to upload a child's face or a family group shot to an unknown website. Unblurry is 100% on-device, so photos never leave the phone, with no subscription, ads or tracking. A holiday card photo or a snapshot of an old print can be finished on the iPhone in your hand.

For portraits, use Portrait & Restore for faces, and try the same mode on old photos.

loc.answer: バッテリー劣化は、最大容量（新品時に対する今の容量）と充放電回数の2つで判断します。iPhoneの設定の「バッテリー」で最大容量を確認でき、80%を下回ると交換を検討する目安とされています。ただし1回の数字より、数週間の推移のほうが参考になります。BattAIはバッテリー状態スコアとスコアを形づくる要因、最大容量の推移をまとめて表示し、各項目に情報源と限界を示します。データは端末に保存し、通信も広告もありません。

en.title: How to check iPhone battery wear before selling or buying used: maximum capacity, the 80% mark and a battery report | BattAI
en.meta: Before trading in or buying a used iPhone, read battery wear properly: what maximum capacity and cycle count mean, the 80% guideline, and how to record the trend in a battery report. No network, no ads.
en.h1: Checking iPhone battery wear: reading maximum capacity and cycle count
en.lead: "It drains faster lately." "I want to check before trading it in." "How low is too low on a used phone?" This page is for people who want to judge battery wear by numbers.
en.answer: Battery wear comes down to two numbers: maximum capacity, the charge the battery holds now compared with when it was new, and cycle count. Maximum capacity appears under Battery in the iPhone's Settings, and dropping below 80% is the usual point to consider a replacement. A trend over several weeks says more than one reading. BattAI shows a battery health score, what shapes the score, and maximum capacity over time, with the source and limits of each detail. Data stays on the device, with no network requests or ads.
paras: Maximum capacity treats the new battery as 100% and shows how much it can hold now. The lower it goes, the sooner the same day of use runs it down, and the more likely the phone is to shut off on cold days or under heavy apps. When buying used or trading in, read this number together with cycle count. Large wear on few cycles can point to heat or charging habits.

Then the trend. Maximum capacity wobbles from day to day, so following several weeks is easier to judge than one look. BattAI shows a battery health score plus what shapes it, maximum capacity over time, charge care, charge range and charge rate. It uses five values from public iOS APIs: battery level, charge state, Low Power Mode, thermal state and time; other results are calculated from those readings or added by you, and each detail shows its source and limits.

When selling or handing a phone on, showing a record moves faster than saying "the battery is fine". BattAI creates a battery report for service, resale or your own records on the device (the app's charts and text, a PNG image, and all your data as a plain-text table) and uploads nothing, with no ads, analytics, tracking, third-party SDKs or internet requests. Unlock once to own every feature; it is not a subscription.

en.h1: Getting the film camera look on iPhone: preview before you shoot, not after
en.lead: Scrolling a feed, the photos that feel like film always stand out. Same iPhone, so why do they look different? This page covers what makes the film look and how to get it from the moment you shoot.
en.answer: The film look comes from grain, halation around bright areas, light leaks and slightly faded color working together. Adding a filter afterwards tends to make every photo feel different; seeing the effect live before you press the shutter lets you set composition and light to suit it. PhotoCream shows 100+ film looks in live preview, and using the same look for a whole outing gives the set one tone. Everything is processed on the device, with no subscription or ads.
paras: The most common reason a film look feels fake is the amount. Heavy grain reads as noise, and light leaks dropped anywhere look staged. On real film, halation and leaks appear naturally around bright light: a window behind someone, evening lamps, a neon sign. Seeing how the effect falls before you shoot, and choosing the direction of light accordingly, changes the result more than any later edit.

PhotoCream turns the phone into a film camera. Grain, halation and light leaks are visible live before the shutter, across 100+ carefully crafted looks spanning retro, cinema, instant and mono. Keep one look for a whole trip or day and the set falls into one tone. Exposure, contrast, curves, HSL and split toning tools, plus text, borders, grain, dust and a date stamp, are there for finishing.

In portraits, skin decides the mood. Frequency-separation smoothing evens skin while keeping eyes, hair and detail sharp, and reshape tools adjust proportions naturally. Every edit happens on the device with nothing uploaded, and a one-time unlock means no subscription and no ads.

steps: Pick a spot with bright light: a backlit window or evening lamps.
Open PhotoCream and swipe through film looks in the live preview.

Use the same look for the other photos from that day so the set matches.
Keep portrait smoothing light, then finish with text or a border.

loc.title: QRコードは開く前に安全確認：偽QR・フィッシング対策をiPhoneで｜QR Code Halo
loc.meta: 駐車場の精算機やチラシに貼られた偽QRコードの手口と、開く前にリンク先を確かめる手順。読み取り後の自動実行をオフにし、端末内でSafe・Caution・Blockedを判定。
loc.h1: そのQRコード、開く前に確認：iPhoneでリンクの安全性を見る手順
loc.lead: コインパーキングの精算機、飲食店のテーブル、駅のポスター。QRコードの上に別のシールが貼られ、偽サイトに誘導される手口が報告されています。このページは、読み取ってから開くまでの間に何を確かめるかをまとめました。
loc.answer: QRコードの安全確認でいちばん大事なのは、読み取ってすぐ開かないことです。まずリンク先のドメイン（host）を目で確かめ、店名や公式サイトと違う、つづりが紛らわしい、短縮URLで中身が見えない場合は開かずにスタッフや公式アプリで確認します。QR Code Haloは設定で「スキャン後に自動で実行」をオフにでき、履歴の「セキュリティチェック」で、ネット上の評判に頼らず端末内で中身をscheme・host・path・queryに分解し、Safe・Caution・Blockedを判定します。javascript:・data:・file: のようなコードは決して開きません。
paras: 偽QRコードの多くは、本物の上にシールを貼るだけの単純な手口です。支払い画面やログイン画面にそっくりなページに誘導し、カード番号やパスワードを入力させます。読み取った瞬間にブラウザが開くと、見た目が本物らしいだけで判断してしまいがちです。だからこそ、開く前にURLの中身を見る一手間が効きます。特に見るべきはhost、つまり「どこのサイトか」の部分です。

QR Code Haloは、初期設定では読み取った瞬間に実行して素早く開くアプリです。安全を優先したい場面では、設定で「スキャン後に自動で実行」をオフにすれば、まず結果を確認してから開くかどうかを決められます。履歴でコードを開いて「セキュリティチェック」をタップすると、Local Payload Security Inspectorが完全なpayloadを端末内で解析し、scheme・host・path・query・fragmentを項目ごとに表示して、Safe・Caution・Blockedの判定と理由を示します。
同じ場所のQRコードを何度も使うなら、QR Verificationが役立ちます。結果を端末内の参照として保存し、次に読み取ったコードをSHA-256フィンガープリントやURL構成要素で比べられるので、前回と中身が変わっていれば気づけます。判定はネット上の評判や曖昧なスコアを使わず、解析できない操作は閉じたままにします。

URLのhost（どこのサイトか）がはっきり表示されるか
判定の理由が項目ごとに示されるか
javascript: や data: のような危険な形式を開かないか

履歴でそのコードを開き、「セキュリティチェック」でSafe・Caution・Blockedの判定と理由を確認する。
CautionやBlockedのとき、または短縮URLで中身が分からないときは開かず、店員や公式アプリで確認する。
よく使う場所のコードはQR Verificationで参照として保存し、次回の読み取りと比べる。

faq: 読み取ったらすぐ開いてしまいますか？
初期設定では読み取った瞬間に実行します。先に確認したいときは、設定で「スキャン後に自動で実行」をオフにしてください。
安全チェックはネットで照会しますか？
いいえ。ネット上の評判や曖昧なスコアは使わず、端末内でpayloadを解析して判定します。
危険な形式のコードはどうなりますか？
javascript:・data:・file: のようなコードは決して開きません。

en.title: How to check a QR code is safe before opening it on iPhone (quishing and fake parking QR codes) | QR Code Halo
en.meta: Fake QR stickers on parking meters and menus lead to phishing pages. Check the link before it opens: turn off auto-run, read the host, and get a Safe, Caution or Blocked verdict on the device.
en.h1: Check that QR code before it opens: reading link safety on iPhone
en.lead: Parking pay stations, restaurant tables, station posters: stickers placed over real QR codes send people to fake sites. This page covers what to check between scanning and opening.
en.answer: The single most important QR safety habit is not opening the link the instant you scan. Read the domain (the host) first; if it does not match the business or official site, uses a confusing spelling, or hides behind a short link, do not open it and check with staff or the official app. QR Code Halo lets you turn off Run action after scanning, and its Security Check in History parses the code on the device into scheme, host, path and query and returns Safe, Caution or Blocked without any network reputation lookup. Codes such as javascript:, data: or file: are never opened.
paras: Most fake QR codes are a sticker over the real one. They lead to pages that imitate a payment or sign-in screen to collect card numbers or passwords. When the browser opens the instant you scan, a convincing page is easy to trust. That is why one extra look at the URL before opening works so well, especially at the host, the part that says which site it really is.

By default QR Code Halo acts the moment it reads a code. When safety comes first, turn off Run action after scanning in Settings and decide after you see the result. In History, open a code and tap Security Check: the Local Payload Security Inspector parses the complete payload on the device into scheme, host, path, query and fragment, and returns Safe, Caution or Blocked with transparent findings.

For codes you use again at the same place, QR Verification helps. Save a result as a local reference, then compare a later scan by its complete SHA-256 fingerprint and URL components, so a swapped code stands out. No network reputation lookup or fuzzy score is used, and parsing uncertainty fails closed.

Is the URL's host shown clearly?
Are the reasons for the verdict listed item by item?
Are dangerous forms such as javascript: or data: refused?
Can you compare a code with the one you scanned last time?
steps: In QR Code Halo Settings, turn off Run action after scanning.
Scan the code and check that the host matches the business or official site.
Open the code in History and tap Security Check to see Safe, Caution or Blocked and why.
If it says Caution or Blocked, or a short link hides the destination, do not open it; ask staff or use the official app.
Save codes you use regularly as a QR Verification reference and compare future scans.
rows: A convincing fake page gets no head start
Host, path and query broken out
You see where the link really goes

en.fits: QR Code Halo suits people who want to check QR codes on parking meters, menus and flyers before opening them: auto-run on or off, Security Check from History and QR Verification on the device, plus 20 barcode formats and QR code creation.
faq: Does it open links as soon as it scans?
By default it acts immediately. To check first, turn off Run action after scanning in Settings.
Does the safety check look things up online?
No. It uses no network reputation lookup or fuzzy score; the payload is parsed on the device.
What happens with dangerous code types?
Codes such as javascript:, data: or file: are never opened.

Snapport는 기기에서 Apple Vision 얼굴 감지를 수행해 머리 위, 눈높이, 턱 가이드를 표시합니다. 핀치, 드래그, 회전으로 미세 조정하고, 얼굴 자동 중앙 정렬과 초기화도 할 수 있습니다. 배경은 흰색, 회색, 파란색, 빨간색으로 바꾸거나 원본을 유지할 수 있고, 기기 내 인물 분할로 전후 결과를 비교합니다. 밝기, 대비, 색온도, 노출, 선명도는 신원 확인에 무리가 없는 가벼운 조정만 제공합니다.

en.title: How to make a passport photo at home: 35×45 mm size, face guides and a print sheet | Snapport
en.meta: Prepare a passport, visa or ID photo at home: 35×45 mm and 2×2 templates, head-top, eye-line and chin guides, a white background and a 4×6 print sheet. Pay once, no subscription, ads or account.
en.h1: Making a passport photo at home: fit the size, then lay it out for printing
en.lead: For anyone renewing a passport with no time for a photo studio. This page walks through size, face position, background and printing in order.
en.answer: A passport photo comes down to four things: the size, how much of the frame the face fills, the background, and the print size. Snapport offers common templates such as 35×45 mm and US 2×2, head-top, eye-line and chin guides for face position, background replacement to white, and 4×6, A4 or Letter print sheets with several copies and cut guides. Everything is processed on the iPhone and photos are never uploaded. Requirements vary by country, agency and application type and Snapport does not guarantee acceptance, so always check the official requirements before submitting.
paras: Home-made passport photos tend to be rejected for the same reasons: the face is too small or cropped too tight, the background has shadows, or the print comes out at the wrong ratio. Start by facing a window with even light, and have someone else take the photo at eye level. Check for glare on glasses or hair over the eyes at this stage.

Snapport runs Apple Vision face detection on the device and shows head-top, eye-line and chin guides. Pinch, drag and rotate to fine-tune, auto-center the face, and reset anytime. Replace the background with white, gray, blue or red, or keep the original, and review the on-device person segmentation before and after. Brightness, contrast, warmth, exposure and sharpness are light adjustments that keep identity intact.

Last comes printing. Export JPEG, PNG or PDF and lay several copies onto a 4×6, A4 or Letter print sheet, then cut along the guides. Snapport is a single purchase with no subscription, in-app purchases, ads, tracking or account, and it uses the network only for an optional template update check that you start yourself.

Switch the background to white and compare before and after around the hair.

loc.meta: 와이파이 신호는 꽉 찼는데 인터넷이 안 될 때, 공유기를 껐다 켜기 전에 확인할 것. 한 번의 탭으로 Wi-Fi·DNS·인터넷을 검사하고 가장 가능성 높은 원인과 근거를 확인하는 순서.
loc.h1: 와이파이는 연결됐는데 인터넷이 안 될 때, 원인부터 찾는 순서
loc.lead: 와이파이 아이콘은 그대로인데 웹페이지가 안 열리고, 카톡도 안 갑니다. 공유기를 몇 번이나 껐다 켜 봤지만 소용이 없을 때를 위한 페이지입니다.
loc.answer: “와이파이 연결됐는데 인터넷 안됨”은 대개 공유기, DNS, 통신사 회선, 특정 사이트 중 한 곳의 문제입니다. 감으로 재부팅을 반복하기보다 어디서 끊기는지를 먼저 확인하면 해결이 빨라집니다. WiFi Aid Lite는 한 번의 탭으로 Wi-Fi, DNS, 인터넷 연결을 한꺼번에 진단해 가장 가능성 높은 원인을 알려 주고, DNS·TCP·TLS·TTFB·HTTP·직접 IP·IPv4·IPv6 결과를 근거로 보여 줍니다. 계정도 광고도 추적도 없고, 기록은 이 기기에만 저장됩니다.
paras: 와이파이 신호가 꽉 차 있다는 건 휴대폰과 공유기 사이의 무선 연결이 살아 있다는 뜻일 뿐입니다. 그 뒤에서 공유기가 인터넷 회선과 연결되지 않았거나, 주소를 찾아 주는 DNS가 응답하지 않거나, 통신사 쪽에 장애가 있을 수 있습니다. 또는 인터넷은 정상인데 자주 쓰는 사이트 하나만 문제일 수도 있습니다. 원인이 어디냐에 따라 공유기를 재부팅할지, DNS 설정을 볼지, 통신사 고객센터에 전화할지가 달라집니다.

WiFi Aid Lite는 여러 독립 경로로 DNS, TCP, TLS, 응답 시간, 안정성을 동시에 검사하고 증거를 교차 비교해 결론을 냅니다. 웹사이트 검사로 특정 사이트만 문제인지 인터넷 전체 장애인지 바로 판별할 수 있고, 정밀 검사는 더 많은 증거와 안정성 샘플을 모아 됐다 안 됐다 하는 간헐적 문제를 가려냅니다. 안정성 분석은 지연 시간의 변동을 관찰해 “연결은 됐는데 자꾸 끊기는” 상태를 찾아냅니다.
고객센터에 전화할 때도 결과가 도움이 됩니다. “인터넷이 안 돼요”보다 “DNS는 응답하는데 TLS 연결이 실패합니다”처럼 말하면 상담이 빨라집니다. 검사 기록은 자동 저장되어 시간대별 변화를 비교할 수 있고, 기록은 이 기기에만 저장되며 클라우드로 전송되지 않습니다.

en.title: Wi-Fi connected but no internet on iPhone: is it the router, DNS or your provider? | WiFi Aid Lite
en.meta: Full Wi-Fi bars but nothing loads? Before restarting the router again, find out where the connection breaks: one tap checks Wi-Fi, DNS and the wider internet and names the most likely cause with evidence.
en.h1: Wi-Fi connected but no internet: find the cause before you restart anything
en.lead: The Wi-Fi icon is full, but web pages will not load and messages will not send. This page is for when restarting the router a few times has not helped.
en.answer: "Connected but no internet" usually means a problem at one of four places: the router, DNS, the provider's line, or one particular site. Finding where it breaks is faster than restarting by guesswork. WiFi Aid Lite checks Wi-Fi, DNS and the internet in one tap, names the most likely cause, and shows the evidence behind it: DNS, TCP, TLS, TTFB, HTTP, direct IP, IPv4 and IPv6. There is no account, ads or tracking, and records stay on the device.
paras: Full Wi-Fi bars only mean the wireless link between phone and router is alive. Behind it, the router may have lost the internet line, DNS may not be answering, or the provider may have an outage. Or the internet is fine and only one site you use is failing. Where the fault sits decides whether to restart the router, look at DNS settings, or call your provider.

WiFi Aid Lite runs independent path, DNS, TCP, TLS, timing and stability checks and compares the evidence to reach a conclusion. Check a Website tells you whether one destination or the wider internet is failing, and Deep Check collects more evidence and stability samples to catch problems that come and go. Variation analysis spots a connection that is up but keeps dropping.

The result helps when you call support too. "DNS answers but the TLS connection fails" gets further than "the internet is broken". Check History keeps past results so you can compare times of day, and records are stored only on this device.
look: Does it check Wi-Fi, DNS and the internet separately in one go?
Does it show evidence for each item, not just a verdict?
Can it tell whether only one site is down?

steps: While connected to Wi-Fi, open WiFi Aid Lite and tap Run a Check.
Read the most likely cause and the item-by-item results for DNS, TCP, TLS and more.
If only one app or site fails, use Check a Website on that address.
If it comes and goes, run Deep Check to gather more stability samples.
If the router is to blame, restart it; if the line is, call your provider with the result in front of you.
rows: Full bars can hide a dead line
A DNS-only fault needs settings, not a restart
The internet may be fine and only that site down
en.fits: WiFi Aid Lite suits anyone whose Wi-Fi is connected but the internet is not, and who wants evidence before restarting the router or calling the provider: one-tap Wi-Fi, DNS and internet checks, with no account, ads or tracking and records kept on the device.
faq: Won't restarting the router fix it?
Only when the router is the cause. If DNS or the provider's line is at fault, repeated restarts change nothing, so find where it breaks first.
Can it tell if only one site is down?
Yes, Check a Website shows whether one destination or the wider internet is failing.
Are my check results sent anywhere?
No. Records are stored only on this device.

loc.title: Diagnostic Wi-Fi sur iPhone : la box, le DNS ou l'opérateur ? | WiFi Aid Lite
loc.meta: Internet en panne alors que le Wi-Fi est connecté ? Avant de redémarrer la box, testez Wi-Fi, DNS et internet en un geste et voyez la cause la plus probable avec les preuves.
loc.h1: Diagnostic Wi-Fi sur iPhone : savoir où ça coince avant d'appeler l'opérateur
loc.lead: Le Wi-Fi affiche toutes ses barres, mais les pages ne chargent plus. Avant de débrancher la box pour la troisième fois, mieux vaut savoir d'où vient la panne.
loc.answer: Une connexion Wi-Fi active sans internet vient presque toujours de l'un de ces quatre endroits : la box, le DNS, la ligne de l'opérateur, ou un seul site. WiFi Aid Lite lance en un geste les tests Wi-Fi et DNS et affiche les preuves détaillées : DNS, TCP, TLS, TTFB, HTTP, IP directe, IPv4 et IPv6. Tester un site indique si un seul site ou l'internet global est en cause, et le test complet ajoute des mesures de stabilité. Sans compte, pub ni suivi ; l'historique reste uniquement sur l'appareil.
paras: Les barres du Wi-Fi ne disent qu'une chose : le téléphone parle bien à la box. Derrière, la box peut avoir perdu la ligne, le DNS peut ne plus répondre, l'opérateur peut avoir une coupure dans le quartier, ou internet fonctionne et seul le site que vous voulez ouvrir est en panne. Selon l'endroit, la bonne réaction change : redémarrer la box, vérifier le DNS, ou appeler le service client.

WiFi Aid Lite sépare ces étapes. Lancer un test vérifie Wi-Fi et DNS en un geste ; Tester un site regarde un site précis ou l'internet global ; le test complet rassemble plus de preuves et de mesures de stabilité. L'analyse de la gigue repère une connexion instable qui fonctionne puis décroche. Chaque conclusion s'appuie sur des preuves listées une par une.

Ces résultats servent aussi au téléphone avec l'opérateur : dire « le DNS répond mais la connexion TLS échoue » fait gagner du temps. L'historique garde les tests précédents pour comparer avant et après, et ces données privées restent uniquement sur l'appareil.

Si une seule application ou un seul site bloque, utilisez Tester un site sur cette adresse.
Si la panne va et vient, lancez le test complet pour mesurer la stabilité.

Seulement si la box est en cause. Si c'est le DNS ou la ligne, redémarrer ne change rien : cherchez d'abord où ça coince.

en.h1: Wi-Fi diagnostics on iPhone: know where it breaks before calling your provider
en.lead: Wi-Fi shows every bar, but pages stop loading. Before unplugging the router for the third time, it pays to know where the fault is.
en.answer: A Wi-Fi connection with no internet almost always comes from one of four places: the router, DNS, the provider's line, or a single site. WiFi Aid Lite runs Wi-Fi, DNS and internet checks in one tap and lists the evidence: DNS, TCP, TLS, TTFB, HTTP, direct IP, IPv4 and IPv6. Check a Website tells one destination from the wider internet, and Deep Check adds stability samples. No account, ads or tracking, and history stays on the device.
paras: Wi-Fi bars only say that the phone can talk to the router. Behind that, the router may have lost the line, DNS may have stopped answering, the provider may have a local outage, or the internet is fine and only the site you want is down. The right response differs for each: restart the router, check DNS, or call support.

WiFi Aid Lite separates those steps. Run a Check covers Wi-Fi, DNS and the internet in one tap; Check a Website looks at one site or the wider internet; Deep Check gathers more evidence and stability samples. Variation analysis spots an unstable connection that works and then drops. Every conclusion rests on evidence listed item by item.

The results help on the phone with your provider too: "DNS answers but the TLS connection fails" saves time. Check History keeps earlier results so you can compare before and after a fix, and the records are stored only on this device.

loc.meta: TOEIC L&Rの勉強時間を増やしてもスコアが伸びないのは、得意な問題ばかり解き直しているから。8分ほどの診断で弱点トップ3を見つけ、毎日1つだけ直して30日目に測り直す勉強法をまとめました。
loc.h1: TOEICのスコアが伸びないときは、まず弱点を診断する
loc.lead: 昇進や異動の条件、就職活動の応募要件でTOEICのスコアが必要なのに、問題集を何周しても点数が動かない。「TOEIC 診断」で検索する人の多くがこの状態です。足りないのは勉強量ではなく、どこで点を落としているかの見極めです。
loc.answer: スコアが伸び悩んだら、まず文法・リスニング・リーディングを短時間で測り、失点の大きい弱点を3つに絞ります。次に、その3つを「直す順番・失点の理由・必要な時間」まで書き出し、毎日1つだけ集中して練習します。30日後に同じ項目を測り直し、初日と並べて比べると、本当に伸びた部分と残った課題がはっきりします。
paras: 問題集を最初から何周もする勉強は、安心感はありますが、得意な問題を解き直す時間が大半になりがちです。たとえばリスニングのPart 2は取れているのにPart 3・4で落としている人が、全パートを均等に練習しても、点数を決めている部分にはあまり時間が回りません。限られた時間で伸ばすには、どこで失点しているかを先に知ることが近道です。
診断で見るべきなのは、正答率だけではありません。文法問題を時間内に解けているか、長文を最後まで読み切れているか、聞き取れなかったのが単語なのか速さなのか。同じ「リーディングが苦手」でも、語彙不足と読む速さ不足では練習方法がまったく違います。失点の理由まで分けると、やるべき練習が具体的になります。
弱点が分かったら、一度に全部を直そうとしないことです。毎日1つのスキルだけを選び、まず短く確認し、次に集中して直し、最後にもう一度確かめる。この3段階を回すと、1日15〜20分でも「今日はこれを直した」という手応えが残り、仕事の合間でも続けやすくなります。
30日ほど続けたら、初日と同じ項目を測り直します。模試の点数だけを見ると日によって上下しますが、スキルごとの正答率やペースを並べると、どこが伸びてどこが残ったかが冷静に分かります。次の30日で何をやるかも、その比較から決めましょう。試験日が近いときは、本番の1・3・7・14日前に何を優先するかを決めておくと、直前の焦りが減ります。

en.title: TOEIC score stuck? Why to diagnose your three weakest skills before studying more
en.meta: If more TOEIC L&R study hours are not moving your score, you are probably re-solving questions you already get right. Find your top three weak skills in about eight minutes, fix one a day, and re-measure on day 30.
en.h1: When your TOEIC score will not move, diagnose before you study
en.lead: You need a TOEIC score for a promotion, a transfer or a job application, yet another pass through the practice book leaves the number where it was. That is where most people searching for a TOEIC diagnosis are. What is missing is not hours but knowing where the points are lost.
en.answer: When your score plateaus, first measure grammar, listening and reading briefly and narrow your losses to three weak skills. Write down the order to fix them, why you lose points and how long each will take, then practise only one each day. After 30 days, measure the same skills again and compare with day one to see what really improved.
paras: Working through a whole practice book again feels safe, but most of the time goes to questions you already answer correctly. Someone who scores well on Part 2 listening but loses points in Parts 3 and 4 gains little from practising every part equally. With limited time, knowing where you lose points comes first.

A diagnosis should show more than accuracy: can you finish grammar questions in time, do you reach the end of long passages, and when listening fails, is it vocabulary or speed? Weak reading caused by vocabulary and weak reading caused by speed need completely different practice. Separating the reasons makes the practice concrete.

Once you know your weak spots, do not try to fix them all at once. Pick one skill a day: check it briefly, practise it intensively, then confirm. Run that loop and even 15 to 20 minutes leaves a clear sense of progress, which makes it easier to keep going around work.

After about 30 days, measure the same skills as on day one. Mock-test scores bounce from day to day, but skill-by-skill accuracy and pace side by side show calmly what improved and what remains, and what to do in the next 30 days. When the test is close, decide in advance what to prioritise 14, 7, 3 and 1 days before.

Aim990 is a diagnostic coach for TOEIC L&R-style study built on this loop. An eight-minute diagnosis of about 20 tasks estimates your practice band and pinpoints your top three weak skills, then turns them into a prescription: what to fix first, why you lose points and how long it takes. Each day you practise one prescribed skill in three phases, and on day 30 you re-measure the same skills against day one. It also includes grammar speed drills, a reading timer, dictation and shadowing, spaced-repetition vocabulary, mock practice and a panic mode for 1, 3, 7 and 14 days before the test. No account, no ads, daily practice works offline, and one purchase unlocks everything with no subscription. TOEIC is a registered trademark of ETS; Aim990 is not affiliated with or endorsed by ETS.

loc.title: ボポモフォ（注音符号）とは？子どもと台湾華語の発音を始める順番
loc.meta: ボポモフォ（注音符号）は台湾の子どもが最初に習う37の発音記号。日本で子どもと台湾華語を始める家庭向けに、聞き分け・なぞり・四声・つなげ読みの順番と1日10分の進め方をまとめました。
loc.h1: ボポモフォ（注音符号）で子どもの台湾華語を始めるには
loc.lead: 「ボポモフォ」で検索するのは、台湾にルーツのある家庭や、台湾への赴任・移住をきっかけに子どもと中国語を始めたい保護者がほとんどです。ピンインではなく注音から入る理由と、家での進め方を先に知っておくと迷いません。
loc.answer: ボポモフォは、台湾の小学1年生が入学して最初の10週間ほどで習う37個の発音記号です。家では①音を聞いて記号を選ぶ、②指でなぞって形を覚える、③四声を聞き分ける、④声母・介音・韻母をつないで1音にする、の順で、1日10分ずつ進めると続けやすくなります。
paras: 注音符号（ボポモフォ）は、ㄅ(b)・ㄆ(p)・ㄇ(m)・ㄈ(f)と続く37個の記号で、台湾では漢字の読みを示すふりがなのように使われています。台湾の絵本や子ども向けの本、小学校の教科書には漢字の横に注音がついていることが多く、台湾の家族と同じ本を読みたい、現地の幼稚園や小学校に通う予定がある、という家庭にはピンインより注音から入るほうが実用的です。
日本語を話す子どもがつまずきやすいのは、四声と、日本語にない音の聞き分けです。ㄓ・ㄔ・ㄕ・ㄖのようなそり舌音や、ㄣとㄥ（-n と -ng）の違いは、目で覚えるより先に耳で何度も聞くほうが定着します。最初の数週間は書く量を増やすより、音を聞いて正しい記号を選ぶ練習を毎日少しずつ続けるのがおすすめです。
形を覚える段階では、筆順どおりに指でなぞる練習が効果的です。ㄅとㄆ、ㄉとㄊのように形が似ている記号は、なぞりながら音も一緒に聞くと混同しにくくなります。四声は、一声（高く平ら）、二声（上がる）、三声（下がって上がる）、四声（下がる）を動きのイメージで覚えると、幼児でも区別しやすくなります。
37個がひととおり読めるようになったら、声母・介音・韻母をつないで1つの音にする「つなげ読み」に進みます。たとえば ㄒ＋ㄧ＋ㄠ で xiao。ここまでできると、注音つきの絵本を自分で声に出して読めるようになり、台湾の祖父母やいとことのやりとりも広がります。
Lumi ボポモフォは、この順番をそのまま遊びにしたアプリです。音を聞いて正しい記号を選んでフレンドにごはんをあげる「フレンドにごはん」、指で一画ずつなぞる「マジックなぞり」、カートの動きで四声を覚える「声調コースター」、声母＋介音＋韻母を組み合わせる「サウンドトレイン」の4つのあそびがあります。広告は一切なく、サインアップも不要で、進み具合は端末内にのみ保存されます。

en.title: Bopomofo for kids in Japan: how to start Taiwanese Mandarin sounds and tones
en.meta: Bopomofo (Zhuyin) is the set of 37 sound symbols Taiwanese children learn first. For families in Japan starting Taiwanese Mandarin with a child: the order of listening, tracing, tones and blending, ten minutes a day.
en.h1: Starting a child on Taiwanese Mandarin with Bopomofo (Zhuyin)
en.lead: Most parents who search for Bopomofo in Japan have Taiwanese family, are moving to Taiwan for work, or want to start Mandarin with their child after a trip. Knowing why Zhuyin comes before Pinyin, and in what order to practise at home, saves weeks of guessing.
en.answer: Bopomofo is the set of 37 phonetic symbols that Taiwanese first graders learn in roughly their first ten weeks of school. At home, go in this order: (1) hear a sound and pick the symbol, (2) trace the symbol with a finger, (3) tell the tones apart, (4) blend initial, medial and final into one syllable. Ten minutes a day is easier to keep up than a long weekend session.
paras: Zhuyin symbols run ㄅ (b), ㄆ (p), ㄇ (m), ㄈ (f) and so on, 37 in all. In Taiwan they work like furigana: picture books, children's books and primary-school textbooks print them next to the characters. If your child will read the same books as Taiwanese relatives, or will attend a local kindergarten or school, starting with Zhuyin is more practical than starting with Pinyin.

Children who speak Japanese usually stumble on tones and on sounds Japanese does not have: the retroflex ㄓ ㄔ ㄕ ㄖ, or the difference between ㄣ and ㄥ (-n and -ng). These stick better through the ear than through the eye, so in the first weeks, short daily practice of hearing a sound and choosing the right symbol beats writing more.

For shapes, tracing in the correct stroke order works well. Look-alike pairs such as ㄅ and ㄆ, or ㄉ and ㄊ, are easier to keep apart when the child hears the sound while tracing. Tones are easiest to remember as movements: first tone stays high and flat, second rises, third dips and rises, fourth falls.

Once the child can read all 37 symbols, move on to blending an initial, a medial and a final into one syllable, for example ㄒ + ㄧ + ㄠ = xiao. At that point a child can read Zhuyin-annotated picture books aloud, which makes conversations with grandparents and cousins in Taiwan much easier.

Lumi Bopomofo turns this order into play: Feed the Friends (listen and pick the right symbol), Magic Tracing (trace each stroke with a finger), Tone Coaster (watch the cart ride to learn the four tones) and Sound Train (blend initial, medial and final into a syllable). It has no ads at all, needs no sign-up, and progress is stored only on the device.

steps: Week one: only listen-and-pick practice with the first symbols (ㄅ ㄆ ㄇ ㄈ).
Trace the symbols the child already recognises by ear, in stroke order.
Compare look-alikes (ㄅ/ㄆ, ㄉ/ㄊ, ㄣ/ㄥ) while saying the sounds out loud.
Act out the tones with a hand: flat, rising, dip-and-rise, falling.
After all 37 symbols, blend two or three into one syllable.
Let the child read one page of a Zhuyin-annotated picture book aloud.

en.fits: Lumi Bopomofo suits families with Taiwanese roots, families about to move to Taiwan, and parents who want to start Taiwanese Mandarin pronunciation together with a child. It does not teach grammar or conversation; it focuses on the pronunciation foundation of Zhuyin symbols, tones and blending. It works on iPhone and iPad.
faq: Should we start with Pinyin or Zhuyin?
If your child will read the same books as family in Taiwan or attend school there, start with Zhuyin. If you mostly use materials from mainland China, Pinyin is the usual choice.
From what age?
Listen-and-pick practice works from about four or five, around the time children start reading hiragana. Tracing only needs a finger that can follow a line.
Can I teach it if I do not speak Mandarin?

loc.h1: 在美國教孩子學注音：在家練習的順序與一次買斷 App 的挑法
loc.lead: 在 App Store 搜「bopomofo」「zhuyin」的，多半是住在美國、加拿大的華人爸媽：孩子聽得懂中文，開口卻越來越少，週末中文學校一週只上一次。注音是讓孩子自己讀得出中文的第一步。
loc.answer: 海外家庭建議從注音開始，順序是：先用聽的分辨 37 個注音符號，再用手指照筆順描寫，接著練四個聲調，最後把聲母、介音、韻母拼成完整的音。每天 10 分鐘在家練，配合週末中文學校的進度。挑 App 時先看是否一次購買就全部解鎖、沒有廣告和內購彈窗、孩子能不能自己操作。
paras: 在英語環境長大的孩子，最常見的情況是「聽得懂、不太說、完全不會讀」。注音就像中文的發音字母，學會之後孩子可以自己讀注音版繪本和台灣的童書，不必每個字都靠爸媽唸。很多海外中文學校也從注音開始教，在家用同一套符號練習，進度最容易銜接。
以英語為主的孩子，最容易卡在聲調和英語沒有的音：ㄓㄔㄕㄖ 的捲舌音、ㄣ 和 ㄥ 的前後鼻音，以及 ㄩ 的發音。這些靠眼睛背很慢，靠耳朵多聽、聽了再選才記得住。前幾週不急著寫，每天先玩幾分鐘「聽音選符號」，效果比一次寫一整頁好。
聲調是海外孩子說中文最容易被聽出「外國腔」的地方。把一聲想成平平的高音、二聲往上、三聲先下再上、四聲往下，用手比動作一起練，孩子比較容易分得清。等 37 個符號都認得，再練把兩三個符號拼成一個音，例如 ㄒ＋ㄧ＋ㄠ。

en.title: Teaching Zhuyin in the US: choosing a pay-once Bopomofo app for heritage families
en.meta: Raising a child in the US whose Mandarin is fading? A Zhuyin starter for heritage families: how to practise at home beyond weekend Chinese school, the order for tones and blending, and a checklist for a one-time-purchase, ad-free Bopomofo app.
en.h1: Teaching Zhuyin at home in the US: the practice order and choosing a pay-once app
en.lead: Most people searching the US App Store for bopomofo or zhuyin are Chinese-speaking parents in the US or Canada whose children understand Mandarin but speak it less and less, with Chinese school only once a week. Zhuyin is the first step to a child reading Chinese on their own.
en.answer: Start heritage learners with Zhuyin in this order: tell the 37 symbols apart by ear, trace them in stroke order, practise the four tones, then blend initial, medial and final into full syllables. Ten minutes a day at home, in step with weekend Chinese school. When choosing an app, check that one purchase unlocks everything, that there are no ads or purchase pop-ups, and that a child can use it alone.
paras: Children growing up in English usually understand Mandarin, speak a little, and cannot read it at all. Zhuyin works like a phonetic alphabet: once learned, children can read Zhuyin-annotated picture books and Taiwanese children's books without a parent reading every word. Many heritage Chinese schools start with Zhuyin too, so practising the same symbols at home keeps progress in step.

English-dominant children tend to stumble on tones and on sounds English lacks: the retroflex ㄓ ㄔ ㄕ ㄖ, the -n/-ng endings ㄣ and ㄥ, and ㄩ. These are slow to learn by eye and much faster by ear: hear, then choose. In the first weeks, a few minutes of listen-and-pick practice each day does more than a full page of writing.

Tones are what make a heritage speaker sound foreign. Picture first tone as high and flat, second rising, third dipping then rising, fourth falling, and act them out with a hand. Once all 37 symbols are familiar, blend two or three into one syllable, such as ㄒ + ㄧ + ㄠ.

There is also a practical point for families abroad: children often practise alone on an iPad, and an ad or paywall makes them tap away or get stuck. An app where one purchase unlocks everything, with no ads, no purchase pop-ups, no sign-up and no internet needed, is easier to hand over, including on a long flight to visit family in Taiwan.

Lumi Bopomofo Pro is the complete edition of the Zhuyin learning game: one purchase unlocks all 37 sounds, every level and every game. There are five games (Match and Feed, Magic Tracing, Tone Roller Coaster, Bopomofo Fishing and Star Race), plus daily goals, achievement badges and weak-spot review, and a parent page shows progress. No ads, no in-app purchase pop-ups, no sign-up, no internet required; progress stays on the child's device. Pay once, play forever, and share with the whole family.

loc.title: 알파벳 쓰기, 몇 살부터 어떤 순서로? 엄마표 영어 10분 루틴
loc.meta: 유아 알파벳 쓰기를 집에서 시작할 때: 대문자와 소문자 순서, b·d 헷갈림 잡는 법, 글자 소리와 함께 익히는 하루 10분 루틴과 앱 고르는 기준을 정리했습니다.
loc.h1: 유아 알파벳 쓰기: 집에서 시작하는 순서와 하루 10분 루틴
loc.lead: ‘알파벳 쓰기’를 검색하는 부모님 대부분은 학원보다 먼저 집에서, 엄마표 영어로 시작하려는 분들입니다. 쓰기만 따로 시키면 아이는 금방 지루해합니다. 소리와 모양을 같이 묶는 순서를 먼저 잡아 두세요.
loc.answer: 만 3~4세는 큰 대문자를 손가락으로 따라 쓰는 것부터, 만 5~6세는 소문자와 글자 소리(파닉스)를 함께 시작하는 것이 무난합니다. 하루 10분, ① 글자 이름과 소리 듣기 → ② 획순대로 따라쓰기 → ③ 소리 듣고 맞는 글자 고르기 순서로 반복하면 쓰기와 읽기의 기초가 함께 자랍니다.
paras: 알파벳 쓰기를 처음 시작할 때 가장 흔한 실수는 A부터 Z까지 한 번에 쓰게 하는 것입니다. 아이 손은 아직 연필을 오래 쥐기 어렵고, 26자를 연달아 쓰면 금방 지칩니다. 처음 몇 주는 하루 두세 글자만, 그것도 작은 칸보다 큰 칸에서 손가락으로 크게 따라 쓰는 정도로 충분합니다.
대문자부터 시작하는 이유는 직선과 큰 곡선이 많아 모양을 잡기 쉽기 때문입니다. 반대로 실제 영어책에서 훨씬 많이 보는 것은 소문자라서, 대문자에 익숙해지면 같은 글자의 소문자를 곧바로 짝지어 익히는 것이 좋습니다. A와 a, B와 b를 한 쌍으로 묶어 두면 읽기로 넘어갈 때 덜 헷갈립니다.
b와 d, p와 q를 자꾸 뒤집어 쓰는 것은 초등 저학년까지도 흔한 일입니다. 혼내기보다 소리와 함께 기억하게 해 주세요. b는 ‘브’, d는 ‘드’ 소리를 내면서 획순 안내선을 따라 쓰면 모양과 소리가 같이 남습니다. 십자 안내선이 있는 칸에서 쓰면 글자 크기와 위치도 금방 잡힙니다.
쓰기만큼 중요한 것이 듣기입니다. 글자 이름(에이, 비)과 글자 소리(애, 브)가 다르다는 것을 일찍 알려 주면 파닉스로 넘어갈 때 훨씬 수월합니다. 소리를 듣고 맞는 글자를 고르는 짧은 놀이를 쓰기 뒤에 붙이면, 아이는 그 시간을 ‘쓰는 시간’이 아니라 ‘노는 시간’으로 기억합니다.

Lumi 레터 Lite는 이 순서를 그대로 놀이로 만든 앱입니다. 글자의 이름과 소리를 듣고, 십자 안내선을 따라 대문자와 소문자를 획순대로 따라쓰고, 소리를 듣고 맞는 글자를 누르는 챌린지로 소리와 모양을 연결합니다. 알파벳 A와 첫 번째 행성을 먼저 해 보고, 마음에 들면 한 번 구매로 26자 전체와 14개 행성, PDF 학습지 내보내기를 열 수 있습니다. 광고가 없고 오프라인에서도 쓸 수 있습니다.

en.title: Alphabet tracing at home: what order, from what age, and a 10-minute routine
en.meta: Starting alphabet writing at home with a preschooler: capitals or lowercase first, how to stop b/d mix-ups, and a ten-minute daily routine that pairs each letter's shape with its sound.
en.h1: Alphabet tracing at home: the order and a 10-minute daily routine
en.lead: Parents who search for alphabet tracing are usually starting English at home before any class. Writing drills on their own bore a small child quickly; tie each letter's shape to its sound from day one.
en.answer: At three to four, start with big capital letters traced with a finger; at five to six, add lowercase and letter sounds (phonics). Ten minutes a day in the order (1) hear the letter's name and sound, (2) trace it in stroke order, (3) hear a sound and pick the matching letter builds writing and reading together.
paras: The most common mistake is asking a child to write A to Z in one sitting. Small hands cannot hold a pencil for long, and 26 letters in a row is exhausting. For the first weeks, two or three letters a day, traced large with a finger, is plenty.

Capitals come first because straight lines and big curves are easier to form. Real books, however, are mostly lowercase, so as soon as a capital feels easy, pair it with its lowercase partner. Learning A with a and B with b as pairs makes the step to reading smoother.

Flipping b and d, or p and q, is normal well into the early school years. Instead of correcting harshly, attach the sound: say /b/ or /d/ while tracing along the guide lines, and shape and sound are remembered together. Writing inside a box with a cross-shaped guide also fixes size and position quickly.

Listening matters as much as writing. Teaching early that a letter's name (ay, bee) differs from its sound (/a/, /b/) makes phonics far easier later. Ending each writing session with a short hear-the-sound, pick-the-letter game also makes the session feel like play rather than work.

Lumi Letters Lite turns this order into play: children hear each letter's name and sound, trace capitals and lowercase in stroke order along a cross-shaped guide, and tap the right letter after hearing a sound. Families can try the letter A and the first planet, then unlock all 26 letters, 14 planets and printable PDF worksheets with one purchase. There are no ads and it works offline.

Listen to each letter's name and sound and say them back.
Trace the capital letter large, following the guide lines.
Trace the matching lowercase letter.
Finish with a hear-the-sound, pick-the-letter game.
At the weekend, write the week's letters once more on paper.

For most children, yes: capitals have more straight lines. Once they feel easy, pair each one with its lowercase letter.

loc.h1: おうち英語でフォニックスを始める順番と、買い切りアプリの選び方
loc.lead: ABCの歌は歌えるのに、「cat の最初の音は？」と聞くと答えられない。フォニックスで検索する保護者の多くがここで立ち止まります。歌の次に必要なのは、単語の中の音を聞き分ける練習です。
loc.answer: 文字の「名前」（エー、ビー）と「音」（ア、ブ）を分けて覚えたら、①単語の最初の音、②最後の音、③まん中の音（短母音）の順で聞き分けます。毎日5〜10分、音を聞いて文字を選び、なぞる練習を続けるのが近道です。月額課金を避けたい家庭は、一度の購入で全部使える買い切りアプリを選ぶと、途中で止まらずに続けられます。
paras: フォニックスは、文字と音の対応を覚えて英語を「読める」ようにする方法です。英語圏の幼稚園では、まず文字の名前と音を分け、次に単語の最初の音、最後の音、まん中の音へと進むのが一般的な順番です。ABCの歌で文字の名前を覚えた子は、次の一歩として「名前ではなく音」に耳を向けるだけで、ぐっと読みに近づきます。
最初の音（cat の /k/）は一番聞き取りやすく、幼児でも遊び感覚で始められます。最後の音（cat の /t/）は少し難しく、まん中の短母音（cat の /a/、cut の /ʌ/）がいちばん難しい段階です。日本語にない短母音の違いは、目で覚えるより何度も聞いて選ぶ練習が効きます。焦らず、最初の音が安定してから次へ進みましょう。
書く練習は、音の練習とセットにすると定着します。音を聞いて文字を選び、そのままガイド線に沿ってなぞる。大文字と小文字を組み合わせる練習も、読み始めると必ず役立ちます。紙のプリントで同じ文字をもう一度なぞると、画面の外でも復習できます。
おうち英語のアプリ選びで保護者が気にするのが、課金のしかたです。数日の体験のあと自動で月額課金が始まるもの、数ステージごとに追加購入が出るものもあります。子どもが毎日開くものだからこそ、何にいくら払うのかが最初から分かり、途中で止まらない形を選ぶと安心です。

Lumi レター Pro は、この順番どおりの本格フォニックスを、14の惑星と12種類の問題、26人の文字のなかま集めで練習するアプリです。単語の最初・まん中・最後の音を聞き分け、大文字と小文字を組み合わせ、十字ガイドに沿って文字をなぞります。保護者ページでは4つの力（文字の認識、アルファベット順、音の認識、絵と音）の伸びが見え、その日練習した文字を入れた「今日のプリント」をPDFで書き出せます。買い切りで、サブスクも自動更新もなく、広告もなし。データ収集もせず、オフラインで使えます。

最初の音が安定したら、最後の音の聞き分けへ進む。

文字の名前を覚え始めた3〜4歳ごろから、最初の音の聞き分けを遊び感覚で始められます。まん中の短母音は5〜6歳ごろからで十分です。
親が英語の発音に自信がなくても大丈夫？
音声が入ったアプリを使えば、保護者は一緒に聞いてまねするだけで進められます。

いいえ。買い切りで、サブスクも自動更新もありません。一度の購入ですべて使えます。

広告はありません。個人情報を集めず、進捗は端末内に保存され、オフラインで使えます。

en.title: Phonics at home after the ABC song: first, last and middle sounds, and choosing a pay-once app
en.meta: For parents starting phonics at home: what comes after the ABC song, the order for hearing first, last and middle sounds in a word, and what to check when choosing a one-time-purchase app instead of a subscription.
en.h1: Starting phonics at home: the order, and choosing a pay-once app
en.lead: Your child can sing the ABC song but cannot tell you the first sound in cat. That is where most parents searching for phonics get stuck. The next step after the song is hearing the sounds inside words.
en.answer: Once a child separates a letter's name (ay, bee) from its sound (/a/, /b/), work on hearing (1) the first sound in a word, (2) the last sound, and (3) the middle sound (short vowels). Five to ten minutes a day of hearing a sound, choosing the letter and tracing it is the shortest path. Families who want to avoid monthly charges can choose a one-time-purchase app so practice never stops halfway.
paras: Phonics teaches children to read by linking letters to sounds. English-speaking kindergartens usually go from letter names and sounds to the first sound in a word, then the last sound, then the middle sound. A child who learned letter names from the ABC song gets much closer to reading simply by turning their attention from names to sounds.

The first sound (the /k/ in cat) is the easiest to hear, so even preschoolers can start playfully. The last sound (the /t/ in cat) is harder, and the short vowel in the middle (the /a/ in cat, the /ʌ/ in cut) is hardest of all. Vowel differences that do not exist in the child's first language are learned by listening and choosing many times. Move on only once first sounds are solid.

Writing sticks better when paired with sound practice: hear a sound, choose the letter, then trace it along guide lines. Matching uppercase to lowercase also pays off as soon as reading starts. Tracing the same letters again on a printed sheet extends practice beyond the screen.

Parents choosing an app for home English often worry about how it charges. Some start a monthly charge automatically after a few days, others ask for another purchase every few stages. For something a child opens every day, it helps to know from the start exactly what you pay for, in a form that does not stop halfway.

Lumi Letters Pro teaches phonics in this order across 14 planets, 12 question types and 26 letter friends to collect. Children hear the first, middle and last sounds in words, match uppercase to lowercase, and trace letters along a crosshair guide. A parent page shows growth in four skills, and a daily worksheet with the letters practised that day can be exported as a PDF. It is a one-time purchase with no subscription or auto-renewal, no ads, no data collection, and it works offline.

Does it progress from first to last to middle sounds?
Is listening practice paired with tracing?
Can parents see strengths and weak spots?

Is it a one-time purchase, or monthly or per-stage charges?
steps: Separate names from sounds, three or four letters a day.
Play a guess-the-first-sound game with pictures for five minutes daily.
When first sounds are solid, move on to last sounds.
For middle short vowels, compare two words and find the difference.
Trace each letter the child picked after hearing its sound.
At the weekend, trace the week's letters again on a printed sheet.

It is not a conversation course; it focuses on the reading foundation of letter-sound links, listening and tracing. Japanese, English, Chinese and Korean interfaces are built in, and one purchase unlocks everything.
faq: From what age can phonics start?
Hearing first sounds can start playfully around three or four, once children know some letter names. Middle short vowels can wait until five or six.
What if I am not confident in English pronunciation?
With an app that plays the sounds, a parent can simply listen and repeat with the child.

No. It is a one-time purchase with no subscription or auto-renewal; one purchase unlocks everything.

There are no ads. It collects no personal data, keeps progress on the device and works offline.

loc.title: Toán cho bé chuẩn bị vào lớp 1: học gì, luyện thế nào 10 phút mỗi ngày
loc.meta: Bé sắp vào lớp 1 cần biết gì về toán? Đếm và nhận biết số, tách – gộp trong phạm vi 10, cộng trừ bằng hình, xem đồng hồ và nhận biết tiền: lộ trình luyện ở nhà 10 phút mỗi ngày, không áp lực.
loc.h1: Toán cho bé trước khi vào lớp 1: lộ trình 10 phút mỗi ngày ở nhà
loc.lead: Phụ huynh tìm “toán cho bé” thường đang lo một điều: con sắp vào lớp 1 mà chưa biết đã sẵn sàng chưa. Điều bé cần không phải là làm thật nhiều phiếu bài tập, mà là hiểu con số bằng hình ảnh và được luyện đều đặn mỗi ngày một chút.
loc.answer: Trước lớp 1, bé nên đếm và nhận biết các số đến 20, hiểu tách – gộp trong phạm vi 10, làm quen với phép cộng, trừ trong phạm vi 10 bằng hình ảnh và biết so sánh nhiều hơn – ít hơn. Mỗi ngày 10 phút với câu hỏi bằng hình (que tính, khung mười ô, tia số) hiệu quả hơn một buổi học dài vào cuối tuần.
paras: Chương trình Toán lớp 1 hiện nay đưa bé đến các số trong phạm vi 100 và phép cộng, trừ không nhớ. Vì vậy trước khi vào lớp, bé không cần học trước cả chương trình; điều quan trọng là phần nền thật chắc: đếm đúng, nhận ra số, hiểu “thêm vào là nhiều hơn, bớt đi là ít hơn” trong phạm vi 10. Bé chắc phần này thì những tuần đầu ở lớp 1 sẽ nhẹ nhàng hơn rất nhiều.

Trẻ 5–6 tuổi hiểu con số qua hình ảnh trước khi hiểu qua ký hiệu. Khung mười ô, que tính, xúc xắc và tia số giúp bé “thấy” được 7 là 5 với 2, hay 10 bớt 3 còn 7. Khi đã thấy được, bé tự nhẩm mà không cần đếm từng ngón tay, và phép tính trên giấy không còn là những ký hiệu khó hiểu.

Áp lực là thứ khiến nhiều bé sợ toán từ trước khi vào lớp. Đừng biến giờ học thành giờ kiểm tra: sai thì làm lại, không chê, không so sánh với bạn. Một câu đúng được khen ngay có tác dụng hơn mười câu bị sửa. Nếu bé mệt hoặc mất tập trung, dừng lại sau 10 phút và hẹn ngày mai.

Ngoài cộng trừ, hai thứ bé gặp mỗi ngày là đồng hồ và tiền. Cho bé xem giờ đúng (7 giờ, 8 giờ) lúc đi học, cho bé đếm tiền khi đi chợ cùng bố mẹ, toán trở thành chuyện của cuộc sống chứ không chỉ nằm trong vở. Khi lên lớp gặp bài xem đồng hồ, bé đã thấy quen thuộc.

Lumi Math Planet biến đếm số, phép cộng, phép trừ, bảng cửu chương, đồng hồ và tiền thành một chuyến phiêu lưu vũ trụ nhẹ nhàng, với 46 dạng câu hỏi bằng hình và có thể đọc to câu hỏi cho bé nghe. Trả lời đúng một câu, một hành tinh nhỏ sẽ sáng lên. Phụ huynh theo dõi tiến bộ, cho bé luyện riêng phần còn yếu và in phiếu bài tập kèm đáp án. Không quảng cáo, không cần tài khoản, chơi được khi không có mạng.
